description: Redefine Epic completion readiness from 'all linked issues delivered' to 'no open linked issue' (all terminal: done/completed or cancelled), sharing one predicate across auto-done, manual Mark Done, resume, and read models. Rename the readiness concept from 'undelivered' to 'open' in Epic scope.

tasks.title: Implement terminal/open Epic readiness rule with shared predicate and rename undelivered to open
tasks.spec: specs/epic-lifecycle/spec.md#Auto-done on issue completion; specs/epic-lifecycle/spec.md#Manual Mark Done retained; specs/epic-lifecycle/spec.md#Epic lifecycle state machine; specs/epic-list-query/spec.md#Epic list progress correctness is preserved
tasks.description: Add shared readiness predicates (IsTerminal, IsOpen, IsReadyToComplete) to EpicProgress and route all readiness consumers through them. Change the readiness rule from 'all linked issues delivered' to 'no open linked issue' (every linked issue terminal). Rename the Epic-scope 'undelivered' concept to 'open' across the aggregate (MarkDone parameter), exception (EpicNotReadyToMarkDoneException property/message), grain method (ComputeUndeliveredLinkedNumbersAsync), read-model local variable, and API 409 payload field. Keep deliveredCount semantics unchanged (done/completed only). Rewrite all affected server tests in terminal/open domain language and add coverage for the mixed done+cancelled epic becoming completable.
acceptanceCriteria: EpicProgress exposes IsTerminal(LinkedIssueDto), IsOpen(LinkedIssueDto), and IsReadyToComplete(IReadOnlyList<LinkedIssueDto>) as the single source of truth for readiness.
EpicProgress.Build sets ReadyToMarkDone = IsReadyToComplete(linked) so a cancelled-only-remaining epic returns readyToMarkDone=true.
EpicGrain readiness computation (renamed ComputeOpenLinkedNumbersAsync) selects linked issue numbers where IsOpen(dto) is true; cancelled issues are excluded from the open set.
Epic.MarkDone parameter renamed from undeliveredLinkedNumbers to openLinkedNumbers; the aggregate-level guard (openLinkedNumbers.Count > 0 => throw) remains as defense-in-depth.
EpicNotReadyToMarkDoneException property renamed from UndeliveredCount to OpenLinkedCount with message updated to use 'open linked issue(s)' domain language.
EpicRoutes 409 payload field renamed from undeliveredCount to openCount; error code EPIC_NOT_READY_TO_MARK_DONE is unchanged.
deliveredCount in EpicProgress.Build still counts only done/completed issues; cancelled issues never increment deliveredCount.
EpicProgress.Build local variable renamed from 'undelivered' to 'open' (the advancement candidate list).
Issue prerequisite domain identifiers (undeliveredPrerequisiteNumbers, IssueGrain.LoadUndeliveredPrerequisiteNumbersAsync, Issue.StartBlocker) are NOT renamed — they are out of scope.
New test: an epic with mixed done and cancelled linked issues (all terminal) auto-transitions to done via ReconcileAfterTerminal (Epic #18 scenario).
New test: an epic with mixed done and cancelled linked issues returns readyToMarkDone=true with deliveredCount counting only the done issues.
New test: a cancelled-only-remaining epic is ready to Mark Done manually and succeeds.

Updated test: existing assertions encoded with the old 'cancelled blocks Epic completion' semantics are rewritten using terminal/open language in EpicProgressSpecs, EpicProgressBuildSpecs, EpicTransitionsSpecs, EpicLifecycleSpecs, EpicAutoDoneHandlerSpecs, EpicReconciliationServiceSpecs, and EpicQuerierListAsyncSpecs.
Existing test for open linked issue blocking readiness still passes (in_progress/backlog issue keeps readyToMarkDone=false and blocks MarkDone).
CliEpicCommandSpecs mock error messages updated to reflect 'open linked issues' wording.
npm test (server, with TreatWarningsAsErrors as lint) passes.
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes (web consumes readyToMarkDone, which is field-name-stable).
tasks.output: Updated production files (EpicProgress.cs, EpicGrain.cs, Epic.Transitions.cs, EpicLifecycleExceptions.cs, EpicRoutes.cs) and rewritten/added test specs; npm test green.

The advancement path (TryStartNextAsync line 378-379) already computes the equivalent of IsOpen locally; promote it to the shared predicate.
